requirement.statement: Halfcode SHALL define RuntimeInstance as a code-owned runtime object system; XNL SHALL declare only instance references and Scope assembly bindings, not runtime fields, methods, message routing, visibility rules, reducers, or state definitions.

case.given: a bundle declares a Runtime node with imperative runtime implementation structure
case.when: the halfcode loader validates the runtime domain
case.then: the loader SHALL reject or diagnose the unsupported structure without treating it as a RuntimeInstance capability declaration

case.given: a dynamic handler, effect, or processor is executed by the halfcode runtime
case.then: the executor SHALL invoke it with runtime as the first argument and SHALL preserve the explicit instanceRefs extension when requested

requirement.statement: Halfcode SHALL resolve and validate each scope-derived reference against the referencing node's Scope chain; a unit-global collection of declared ids SHALL NOT be represented as scope visibility.

case.given: nested scopes bind the same RuntimeInstance id
case.when: a descendant uses scope.runtime:// for that id
case.then: the resolver SHALL select the nearest visible binding

case.given: a RuntimeInstance id is bound only in a sibling Scope
case.when: another sibling uses scope.runtime:// for that id
case.then: the loader or scope-aware resolver SHALL report it as unresolved rather than accepting the unit-global declaration

requirement.statement: Halfcode runtime assembly SHALL convert failures from injected host resolvers, including config resolution, into scoped diagnostics and SHALL continue reporting independent assembly failures when safe.

case.given: the host config resolver throws for a declared runtime or Scope config reference
case.then: assembly SHALL return a configuration-resolution diagnostic and SHALL NOT leak the host exception as an uncategorized failure

requirement.statement: Halfcode unit loading SHALL support an explicit domain-file inventory when directory enumeration is unavailable; directory discovery MAY remain an authoring convenience but SHALL NOT be the only valid loading mode.

case.given: a packaged bundle provides its domain documents through an explicit inventory and the resolver has no readDir capability
case.when: the loader reads a FrontendApp unit
case.then: the loader SHALL load and validate the declared domain documents without requiring directory enumeration

requirement.statement: Halfcode SHALL document and test the compatibility relation between the public FrontendApp API version and the loader's bundle representation version; the two version names SHALL NOT be treated as an undocumented alias.

case.given: a FrontendApp declares the supported halfcode.dg-cell-mvi/v1 API
case.when: the current hierarchical loader representation reads it
case.then: the compatibility contract SHALL identify the accepted combination and the diagnostic behavior for unsupported combinations

requirement.statement: The dg-cell-mvi DSL documentation and eidolon-workbench behavior registry SHALL distinguish a RuntimeInstance object runtime from any legacy event/reducer MVI store, so each behavior has one unambiguous source of truth.

case.given: the workbench publishes halfcode runtime behavior
case.when: an implementer reads the behavior registry and DSL runtime specification
case.then: the documents SHALL agree that RuntimeInstance behavior is code-owned and Scope-assembled
